name: owlmastery
description: Connects Codex to the Owl Mastery MCP server and teaches it to read gamma levels, implied volatility and market data.

interface.shortDescription: Gamma levels, implied volatility and market data
interface.longDescription: Read Owl Mastery's daily gamma levels, implied volatility and market overview for US stocks and indexes. Needs an Owl Mastery API key in OWLMASTERY_API_KEY.
defaultPrompt: Use Owl Mastery to show NVDA's gamma levels against its close.
Use Owl Mastery to summarize how the market and its sectors did today.
